messages:
maria: FYI saw a pattern in this morning's surge where leads rapidly flip owners during HS webhook storms. opening thread to propose an adaptive mitigation.

leo: example?

maria: two samples: lead-AC1: 10:02:11 -> A, 10:02:14 -> B, 10:02:22 -> C. enrichment landed at 10:03:00. HubSpot webhooks show duplicate delivery ids.

tara: classic retry + rotation re-eval. earlier fixes helped but at high qps the static splay still too small.

analytics-bot: spike detected: webhook_rate 420/s @10:02-10:05, reassigned_count 4x baseline. correlated with enrichment_latency > 30s.

samir: proposal: adaptive splay that scales with webhook_rate and enrichment lag. when webhook_rate > 200/s set splay_window = min(120, base_splay * ceil(webhook_rate/200)). also add owner_affinity_score to bias reassigns to original owner for N seconds.

maria: hmm. so simple formula: splay = base_splay * max(1, ceil(rate/200)). want a fallback cap too.

leo: and add tag exemptions for VIP/paid_trial. VIPs always immediate assign.

maria: pseudocode:
```
if lead.tags intersects {"vip","paid_trial"}:
  splay = 0
elif webhook_rate > 200:
  splay = min(120, base_splay * ceil(webhook_rate/200))
else:
  splay = base_splay
```

emily: I like adding owner_affinity_score: when a lead is first assigned, set affinity=1.0 then decay over 60s. reassign->choose owner with max(affinity * availability_score).

samir: also recommend short claim_lease (20s) during high splay so transient churn is avoided.

analytics-bot: metric suggestions: owner_affinity_age, reassigned_count_per_lead, splay_applied_rate. can post smoke baseline for comparison.

maria: rollout plan: 1) config flag behind toggle, 2) 30m staging replay with synthetic 500rps, measure reassigned_count, 3) 5% canary for 6h, 4) ramp if reassigned_count drops >60% at 95p.

leo: add safety: if reassigned_count increases after canary, auto rollback. tie to alert -> #support.

tara: tests: VIP bypass, casefold owner email to avoid SF mapping misses, webhook idempotency header handling, sticky_affinity expiry tests.

maria: I'll open PR with config and test checklist now. tagging @samir @emily @leo. ETA EOD.

samir: will wire in alerts and dashboard panels. emily will provide baseline numbers for comparison.

emily: will drop a quick doc with expected metric deltas and a sample grafana dashboard. will also add a short blurb for SDRs about what circuit flags mean.

maria: thanks all. if staging looks good we flip during low traffic tomorrow 02:00 PT. :rocket:
